# resilience

Timeouts before retries, retry with backoff+jitter, circuit breaker and bulkhead - the AWS Builders' Library canon behind the AF-RES family and AF-PERF-005/007.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-PERF-005` | high | Timeouts exist before retries, and retries carry jitter |
| `AF-PERF-007` | medium | Sync work does not block the request path unnecessarily |
| `AF-PERF-101` | high | HTTP call site without a visible timeout |
| `AF-PERF-102` | medium | Retry without backoff |
| `AF-PERF-103` | low | Retry without jitter |
| `AF-PERF-104` | high | Retry wrapping a mutating call |
| `AF-PERF-105` | medium | No circuit breaker declared in the project |
| `AF-PERF-106` | medium | Connection pool usage without a visible bound |
| `AF-PERF-107` | medium | No graceful shutdown hook declared in the project |
| `AF-PERF-108` | medium | No idempotency mechanism declared in the project |
